title: umask_snapshot v1
description: The umask declared by every system-wide shell and login source, read in one pass. The engine takes the least restrictive declaration and compares it bit by bit with P-07. A source read without any declaration is left out.

status.description: read, absent (the file does not exist: nothing to declare) or unreadable.

umasks.description: Octal umask declarations found, normalised to 3 or 4 digits, in file order.

uninterpretable.description: Declarations that are not octal (symbolic u=rwx, variables): the file's umask cannot be known.
